title: Starting at 25 vs 35: The $400,000 Gap

beats.say: Waiting just ten years to invest $200 a month destroys massive wealth.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a single hourglass on a dark wooden table, dramatic side lighting, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: Here is the exact math behind that delay.
beats.visual: A vintage metal desk lamp casting a warm glow over a blank leather notebook and a fountain pen.

beats.say: If you start at 25 and invest $200 a month at 8% a year until 65...
beats.visual: Close-up of a hand placing a single silver coin onto a dark slate surface, moody shadows.
A steaming ceramic mug of dark coffee on a rustic wooden table, early morning window light filtering through blinds.

beats.say: That is built on monthly compounding over forty years.
beats.visual: A wall clock ticking in a dimly lit room, motion blur on the sweeping second hand.

beats.say: But what happens if you wait until 35 to start?
beats.visual: A person's silhouette walking down a long, quiet hallway with receding overhead lights.

beats.say: You only have thirty years left until age 65.
beats.visual: Close-up of a calendar page turning in soft focus, muted neutral tones.

beats.say: That same $200 a month at 8% a year drops to $298,072.
beats.visual: A calculator resting on a dark mahogany desk, keys softly illuminated by a desk lamp.
A hand sliding a blank ledger notebook across a textured concrete surface.

beats.say: Saving a little cash upfront costs you a fortune later.
beats.visual: A heavy iron key sitting on a dark oak tabletop, moody cinematic contrast.

beats.say: The difference between those two outcomes is a staggering $400,130 lost.
beats.visual: A close-up of a dark fountain pen resting beside a blank sheet of heavy paper.

beats.say: Time is your greatest asset, and that is exactly how
beats.visual: A hand closing a dark leather journal, soft rim lighting from the side.

beats.say: waiting just ten years to invest $200 a month destroys massive wealth.
beats.visual: A dark, empty corridor with a single warm light at the far end, cinematic minimalism.

caption:
Waiting a decade to start investing is the most expensive mistake you can make. Time beats timing every single day.
